_about: The daily study verse. The rhythm follows the seasonal reading guides: a year of four seasons, each season three movements of four weeks, and a closing week;
each week six verse days and a day of rest; each day one verse (or a few) with a short title that says why it belongs to this week. The order is the argument:
a movement is a posture (attend, confess, gather), and the weeks within it move from the ground of the matter to its witness to its fulfilment.

Season start is fixed to the winter solstice (start), then 13 weeks of 7 days each; the last two days of the year (the turn) follow week 52. No state, no streaks: a reader who misses days resumes where the calendar is.

References use the archive's stored numbering (Septuagint for the Old Testament), as the verse pages do: Psalms 29:6 is Psalm 30:5 in English Bibles. tools/export_site.py checks every reference against the stored text.
Every title is written to the stored wording of its verse. Any new prose here is drafted for Boss to read before it goes live.

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.line: The dark season is holy ground.

movements.name: The Dark Ground
movements.line: Begin where God began: in the dark, and not alone.

weeks.name: Before the Light
days: God divides the light from the darkness
Darkness is not dark to God
The light shines in the darkness

weeks.name: Wait for the Lord
days: My soul has hoped in the Lord from the morning watch
Those who wait on God renew their strength
The vision waits for its time
Hope unseen, waited for with patience

weeks.name: The Long Night
days: Weeping for a night, joy in the morning
Why are you so sad, O my soul?
Where is God, who appoints the night watches?
He came in the fourth watch

weeks.name: The Watch
days: I watch in the morning and the night
I remembered you on my bed
Watch, for you do not know the hour

movements.name: The Light Comes
movements.line: The light does not cancel the dark season. It enters it.

weeks.name: The Great Light
days: A great light for those in darkness
The true light, coming into the world
I am the light of the world

weeks.name: The Star
days: Be enlightened, for your light has come

weeks.name: The Lamp and the Word
days: The manifestation of your words enlightens
A city set on a hill
Once darkness, now light in the Lord

weeks.name: Fire in the Cold
days: A pillar of fire by night
The bush that was not consumed
After the fire, the voice of a gentle breeze
A fire shut up in my bones
Did not our hearts burn within us?

movements.name: The Hidden Seed
movements.line: What looks dormant is being kept.

weeks.name: The Seed in the Ground
days: Seed and harvest shall not cease
The seed grows, he knows not how
Unless a grain of wheat falls
What you sow must die first

weeks.name: The Hidden Years
days: A child hidden for three months
Hidden in the shadow of his hand
Your life is hidden with Christ
In the wilderness until the day

weeks.name: Refuge
days: God is our refuge and strength
Dwelling in the help of the Most High
My help comes from the Lord
The name of the Lord is of great strength
Good to those who wait on him in the day of affliction

weeks.name: Dawn Is Coming
days: Satisfied in the morning with your mercy
Your light shall break forth like the dawn
The sun of righteousness shall arise
Very early, when the sun had risen

closing.name: The Eighth Day
closing.line: What the dark kept, the light now shows.
days: Led on a path they have not known
Light has sprung up for the righteous
At evening time there shall be light
Behold, I am making all things new

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.line: New growth is most exposed when it is youngest.

movements.name: The Sowing
movements.line: Plant before you can see the harvest.

weeks.name: The Sower
days: A sower went out to sow
The seed is the word of God
The word goes out and does not return empty
Sow for righteousness; gather the fruit of life
Do not grow weary in doing good

weeks.name: Good Soil
days: The seed on good soil bears fruit
An honest and good heart holds the word fast
Keep your heart with the utmost care
Receive with meekness the implanted word

weeks.name: Small Beginnings
days: Who has despised the small days?
A tender twig becomes a cedar
Let no one despise your youth

weeks.name: The Rains
days: The early and the latter rain
He will come to us as the rain
You visit the earth and water it
The farmer waits for the precious fruit
Water poured on the thirsty land

movements.name: The Guarding
movements.line: The young are the most exposed. Watch what is planted.

weeks.name: The Vineyard
days: A song of my beloved and his vineyard
A vine brought out of Egypt
Apart from me you can do nothing

weeks.name: Thorns and Weeds
days: An enemy sowed weeds among the wheat
Let both grow together until the harvest
The cares of the world choke the word
A neglected field, barren and overgrown

weeks.name: Watch and Pray
days: Why has your face fallen? Be still
The spirit is willing, the flesh is weak
Your adversary prowls like a lion
Stand against the schemes of the devil
I have prayed for you, that your faith may not fail
Let anyone who thinks he stands take heed

weeks.name: Wise as Serpents
days: Wise as serpents, innocent as doves
The Bereans examined the Scriptures daily
Test everything; hold fast what is good

weeks.name: The Lamb
days: When I see the blood, I will pass over you
Like a lamb led to the slaughter
Ransomed with the precious blood of Christ

weeks.name: The Cross
days: Where is the sheep for the offering?
My God, why have you forsaken me?
I have been crucified with Christ

weeks.name: The Empty Tomb
days: He is not here; he has risen
Why do you seek the living among the dead?
He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures
It was not possible for him to be held by death

weeks.name: The Firstfruits
days: Christ, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep
O death, where is your victory?
Set your minds on things above

closing.name: The Eighth Day
closing.line: The winter is past; what was sown is rising.
days: Behold, I will do new things
A new heart and a new spirit
You renew the face of the ground
I will be as dew to Israel
The Spirit who raised Jesus dwells in you

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movements.name: The Work
movements.line: Work is a gift before it is a burden.

weeks.name: Work in the Garden
days: Placed in the garden to cultivate and keep it
Man goes out to his work until evening
Whatever your hand finds to do
Work heartily, as for the Lord

weeks.name: Diligence
days: The hands of the vigorous make rich
The hand of chosen men shall rule
The hands of the active are diligent
Where there is care, there is abundance
The diligent man attends on kings
Do not be slothful in zeal

weeks.name: Faithful Stewards
days: The Lord was with Joseph, and he prospered
Remember the Lord, who gives power to get wealth
Required of stewards: that they be found faithful
Good stewards of God’s varied grace

weeks.name: Honest Hands
days: A false balance is an abomination
He who builds his house without justice
Against those who cheat the hired worker
The wages you kept back cry out
Let him labor, doing honest work

movements.name: The Rest
movements.line: A people who cannot stop are not free.

weeks.name: Remember the Sabbath
days: God rested on the seventh day
A sign forever between God and Israel
Remember that you were a slave
The Sabbath was made for man

weeks.name: Come to Me
days: Come to me, all who labor
The Lord tends me as a shepherd
He gives to his beloved sleep
In peace I will lie down and sleep
Come away by yourselves and rest
My peace I give to you

weeks.name: The Rest That Remains
days: A Sabbath rest for the people of God
Today, if you hear his voice
I myself will go before you and give you rest
When you turn and mourn, you shall be saved
Let us fear lest any seem to have failed to reach it

weeks.name: Release
days: The land shall keep a Sabbath
Proclaim a release upon the land
A release of debts every seventh year
Good news to the poor, liberty to the captives

movements.name: The Long Day
movements.line: Endurance is the work of wisdom.

weeks.name: Burden and Heat
days: Parched by day, chilled by night
The sun shall not strike you by day
He gives power to the faint
The burden of the day and the scorching heat
Do not grow weary in well-doing

weeks.name: Wisdom’s House
days: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom
Trust in God with all your heart
If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask
If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments

weeks.name: The Race
days: Run with endurance the race set before us
Run so as to obtain the prize
The soldier, the athlete, the farmer
They go from strength to strength

weeks.name: Trials and Joy
days: He has tried me as gold
Brought out to a place of abundance

closing.name: The Eighth Day
closing.line: The work is done, and the rest remains.
days: God saw everything that he had made, and it was very good
Establish the work of our hands
You shall eat the labors of your hands
The sleep of a servant is sweet
Seek first the kingdom of God
They rest from their labors, and their deeds follow them

seasons.name: Fall
seasons.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movements.name: The Attention
movements.line: Hear the alarm while there is time to answer.

weeks.name: The Trumpet
days: Sounded in remembrance before the Lord
With trumpets and the sound of the horn
A day of trumpet blast and battle cry
An indistinct sound from the bugle

weeks.name: Wake Up
days: The hour has come to wake from sleep
Let us not sleep, but keep awake
Lest your hearts be weighed down
Wake up, and strengthen what remains
How long will you lie there, O sluggard?

weeks.name: Count the Year
days: Who knows how to number his days?
Know the number of your flock
The rich man and his full barns

weeks.name: The Reckoning
days: Each of us will give an account
We must all appear before the judgment seat
Naked and exposed to the eyes of him

movements.name: The Atonement
movements.line: Name it. Bring it. Be cleansed.

weeks.name: Confession
days: I did not hide my iniquity
He who covers his ungodliness will not prosper
Confess your sins to one another
I confess the sins of the people of Israel
He is faithful and just to forgive

weeks.name: The Day of Atonement
days: On this day atonement shall be made for you
The goat bears all their iniquities
The life of the flesh is in the blood
Whom God put forward as a propitiation
Once for all, by his own blood
Draw near with a true heart

weeks.name: Mercy
days: As far as the east is from the west
He will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea
Though your sins be as purple, I will make them white
Create in me a clean heart

weeks.name: Forgiven, Therefore Forgiving
days: Be merciful, as your Father is merciful
Forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you
Bear with one another and forgive

movements.name: The Ingathering
movements.line: Rejoice, and leave the corners for the poor.

weeks.name: The Feast of Booths
days: The nations go up to keep the Feast of Booths
On the last day of the feast, Jesus cried out

weeks.name: The Portion for the Poor
days: Leave the edges of your field
The sheaf you forgot is for the sojourner
Pull out some handfuls for her
He who has pity on the poor lends to the Lord
If you pour yourself out for the hungry

weeks.name: The Table for All
days: A feast of rich food for all peoples
You prepare a table before me
Invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind
That my house may be filled
Many will come from east and west
Breaking bread with glad and generous hearts

weeks.name: Thanksgiving
days: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good
You shall bless the Lord for the good land
Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts

closing.name: The Eighth Day
closing.line: The year is gathered, and the corners are left for the poor.
days: Rejoice in all the good the Lord has given
You crown the year with your bounty
With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation
A great multitude from every nation
The tabernacle of God is with men
Fasts turned to feasts of joy and gladness

turn: To your old age I am he
You are the same, and your years have no end
